formDescription: Collects which BC Government ministry/agency (public body) holds the records being requested. General requests can select multiple ministries (a $10 non-refundable fee applies per ministry selected). Personal requests are limited to a single ministry, and for certain request topics the ministry is locked to a fixed value (e.g. Children and Family Development for adoption/child-protection/foster-parent/youth-in-care topics).

selected_ministry.title: What ministry or agency has the records you are looking for?
selected_ministry.description: General requests: select one or more. Personal requests: select exactly one, unless the ministry is locked by the request topic (in which case this control is disabled and pre-selected).

notes: Ministry list is loaded dynamically from web/src/app/services/data.json (referenceData.ministries), not FormGroup-bound (selection is tracked on plain objects, not Angular reactive forms). Selecting EAO, FOR, or ENV surfaces additional contextual warning text but does not add form fields.
